title: Vivumishi (Theme 7: Kuhudumia wenye mahitaji maalum)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses the possessive and the number after the noun, both with its class prefix, usually possessive first (vitabu vyangu vitatu).
steps: Find the noun and its class.
Add the number with its prefix.
contexts: serving those with special needs: viti vyetu vitatu vya magurudumu

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kivumishi kimilikishi kipi?" Kwa nini "wawili" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni kivumishi cha idadi kipi?" Kwa nini "wangu" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi imepangwa sawa?" Kwa nini "Wawili watoto" si jibu sahihi?

misconceptions.repair: Kwa kawaida kimilikishi hutangulia idadi: watoto wangu wawili.
